title: New RSO Registration and Recognition (2026-27 Cycle)
text:
New RSO Registration and Recognition (2026-27 Cycle)

Timing and eligibility: Recognition is annual. Status for 2026-27 covers one academic year (August 1 to June 30), and approved applications last through June 30, 2027. Organizations that don't complete the process on time don't receive recognition for the year and lose all benefits. Benefits start only once an RSO is recognized. Groups that applied in the fall should not submit a new application. Social fraternities and sororities are recognized through the Office of Fraternity & Sorority Life instead.

Key deadlines: October 27: application opens. November 22, 11:59 pm: application closes. The page states 'Late applications are not accepted.' December 1: advisor requirements due. Advisors can start anytime and don't need to wait for the RSO's application.

Registration path for a new RSO: 1. Go to the EngageSC Directory (engage.usc.edu/club_signup) on a laptop or desktop. Search by keyword first to check for an existing page. 2. Click the blue box labeled '+Register a new Recognized Student Organization.' Groups with religious or spiritual activities select '+Register a new Office of Religious and Spiritual Life' instead. 3. Click the button to begin the application.

Re-establishing an RSO with an existing EngageSC page must first submit a form to be added as an officer, then open the group page and scroll down to begin.

Membership requirements: five required officers (president, vice president, secretary, treasurer, and programming chair). One full-time USC faculty or staff advisor who is not on sabbatical or leave. At least five additional student members. All officers and members must accept their positions through EngageSC, using the email from mailer@campusgroups.com on a laptop or desktop. The application can proceed before everyone accepts. (Note: the Campus Activities FAQ page states at least 10 currently enrolled student members; verify.)

Application documents: Constitution, using the required 2026-27 fillable template (do not print to PDF or flatten it). Accountability Document, using the required 2026-27 fillable template, following the provided instructions and sample.

Officer requirements (each of the five officers): Hazing Prevention 101: Student Edition 2026-2027; RSO Officer Learning Path (completed between July 1, 2026 and the application deadline); Commitment to Community form, completed through DocuSign.

Only one officer submits the application, and only that officer can view or edit it. Each student may submit for only one RSO.

Advisor requirements (due December 1): The advisor must be a full-time USC faculty or staff member and agree to the duties in the constitution, such as meeting with the RSO at least once a semester. Complete the RSO Advisor Training on Reach360, starting by logging in to usc.reach360.com with SSO. Complete the Commitment to Community form through DocuSign. Submit the advisor training certificate and Commitment to Community form through the Advisor Requirements Google Form. Clery Act training is tracked through TrojanLearn; advisors don't submit a certificate.

Contact: Questions and accessibility accommodations: stuacts@usc.edu (the footer lists campact@usc.edu). Phone: 213-740-5649. Office: Steven & Kathryn Sample Hall (SKS) 410, 3607 Trousdale Parkway, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.
